title: From Software Requirements Specifications to Agile User Stories Using Large Language Models: A Structured Critical Review and Proposed Evaluation Framework
description: Author-review research materials for a purposively selected, single-reviewer structured critical review, with a proposed (not empirically validated) source-grounded evaluation framework. Appendix A provides literature-landscape scoping: 207 imported records, 26 duplicate entries, and 181 distinct bibliographic candidates; these are not the included-study count.
